name: dicavo
description: Ask about your meetings recorded with Dicavo on this Mac: AI summaries, transcripts, action items, people and recurring meetings. Read-only.

interface.shortDescription: Your recorded meetings, from Dicavo on this Mac
interface.longDescription: Ask about the meetings you recorded with Dicavo: AI summaries, transcripts, action items, people and recurring meetings. The plugin starts Dicavo, installed from the Mac App Store, as a local read-only server. Dicavo Pro and Access for AI agents in Dicavo's settings are required.
interface.defaultPrompt: What did we agree in my last meeting, and what is still open?
